You can search and download it from the watch's app store, or click on your profile picture at the bottom of the watch's app store. There, you'll find "Purchased Items." Click to download.

- After granting network permissions, there are often network errors in responses.
    The interruptions in responses occur because the watch screen darkens, causing the app to freeze. The watch defaults to screen darkening (system sleep) after 15 seconds. When asking questions, try rotating the watch crown to keep the system active, and you'll have no problems. Alternatively, go to the watch's settings, find Display & Brightness, adjust the Wake Screen duration to 70 seconds for a better experience.

- How do I export conversations?
    In your conversation history, there's an export icon on the right side of each record. Or, after asking a question, there's an export icon at the bottom of the answer page. Export via email or iMessages.

- No sound after enabling the text-to-speech feature for answers?
    Make sure your watch isn't on mute, and check the volume level in the top right corner of the app. After turning off mute mode, you need to restart the app (exit it from the app dock).

- How do I adjust the volume?
    Tap the volume icon in the top right corner, then rotate the watch crown. After adjusting the volume, click anywhere else to confirm.

- Issues with interface language and keyboard language.
    Languages are divided into interface language and keyboard language. The interface language will follow the system display, so Chinese phones display simplified or traditional Chinese characters for easier understanding. The keyboard language is a function of the watch itself. On the keyboard page, there's a triangular symbol at the bottom. Swipe up from the bottom to switch keyboards. If the desired keyboard language isn't available, add the language on your phone. The watch will synchronize automatically.

This app converts a date between Julian Day of Year and Gregorian.  For example, September 11, 2022 converts to 2022-254 and 2022-254 converts to September 11, 2022.

This app will convert both directions.

Julian Date for this app refers to the day-of-year number (more properly, the ordinal date) in the Gregorian calendar, often used in mainframe computer systems, the military and the food industry. (Note: this app does not used the term Julian Date to refer to the astronomy definition which is calculated from 4713 BC)

Features a simple clean interface with pickers for the dates.

The app also features a monthly view allowing a quick view of both Gregorian and Julian days for the entire month.

Widgets are available for both the Home Screen and the Lock Screen to display the current day of year.

A Watch app is available that includes a date converter and complications to display the current day of year.

Note:  The app's icon does not change to reflect the current day.
